title: dryopteris loxoscaphoides
intro: Dryopteris loxoscaphoides, commonly known as Chinese golden shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris loxoscaphoides include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant are thought to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects of these compounds.
